campaign_id = params[:id]\n    enc_id = params[:enc_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    target_index = parse_optional_index(@body['index'] || @body['position'])\n    if target_index ==   render json: { error: 'not your turn' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      target_index = count - 1 if target_index.nil?\n\n      if target_index <= turn_index || target_index >= encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, enc_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      combatants = JSON.parse(encounter[3] || '[]')\n      ordered = encounter_turn_order(combatants, encounter[7])\n campaign_id = params[:id]\n    enc_id = params[:enc_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    target_index = parse_optional_index(@body['index'] || @body['position'])\n    if target_index == :invalid\n      bad_request('invalid index')\n      return\n    end\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      unless enc_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      combatants = JSON.parse(encounter[3] || '[]')\n      ordered = encounter_turn_order(combatants, encounter[7])\n      count = ordered.length\n\n      if   render json: { error: 'not your turn' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      target_index = count - 1 if target_index.nil?\n\n      if target_index <= turn_index || target_index >= enc_id = params[:enc_id]\n    username = @current_user[:username]\n\n    GameStorage.with_lock do\n      campaign = find_play_campaign(campaign_id)\n      return unless campaign\n\n      is_owner = encounter = find_encounter(campaign_id, enc_id)\n      return unless encounter\n\n      combatants = JSON.parse(encounter[3] || '[]')\n      ordered = encounter_turn_order(combatants, encounter[7])\n      count = ordered.length\n\n      if count == 0\n        render json: { error: 'no combatants' }, status: :conflict\n        return\n      end\n\n      round = encounter[4] || 1\n      turn_index =
